card.name: Linn's triple berry preserves
card.description: Triple berry preserves for buttered toast, a bowl of yogurt, or a plain cake that deserves a little company. Keep a jar where breakfast happens.

meet_the_maker.name: Linn's
meet_the_maker.story: Linn’s story starts with a family and a Central Coast farm. They have been growing crops and making food since 1979, with the next generation still working the land. These preserves belong on real bread, with real butter. A modest breakfast can be a very good meal.
